_about: SSO's five string sections' Performance legato transitions by the note before (attack: A attacked after silence; transition: Z, A, B in one direction), its length (136 / 273 / 500 / 1000 ms) and B's own length (IOI after: 136 / 300 ms), CC119 speed played (the script writes it from the spacing as played) or written ([slurs] speedFromWritten 1: the script's writing off, CC119 sent from the written spacing; here played = written, no early start, so the two should agree up to take noise), as plain Performance plays them: velocity 64 for the attack and the transitions, the note before held 24 ms into the next, CC1 64, CC11 127. 3 pitches per section (the legato_glide registers), intervals -2 / +2, 2 takes in ABBA order, 1.6 s of silence between figures (round robins reset), random modulators on (as shipped). Measured 2026-10-21 on the Windows test VM: Kontakt 8 + SSO, the VM MuseScore's setups (library defaults, max voices 512), offline, by kthost from tools/soundlibraries/kthost through measure_patch.py (docs/MEASURING.md). Times in ms after B's note-on: leave / mid / arrive = the f0 0.1 / 0.5 / 0.9 of the way from A's pitch to B's (YIN, legato_glide/glide.py's rule); heardRef = leave + 23.5 ms is the PERCEPTUAL REFERENCE (the owner by ear, 2026-10-21: transitions arriving 130-200 ms late sounded on time; Polfreman 2013), arrive is not the heard time. by: '<before>/<beforeLenMs>/<ioiMs>/<speed>' -> measure -> n (takes pooled over pitches and intervals), median, p10, p90, takeSd (median of the cells' take SD). Measurement only: the renderer doesn't read this file.
